LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonAcidRain.label: flesh moon acid rain
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonAcidRain.description: The flesh moon saturates the clouds with caustic bile, rapidly poisoning and burning anything left exposed outside.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonAcidRain.letterText: Caustic rain is falling from the flesh moon. Keep pawns, animals, crops, and supplies under roof.
